workItems.objective: Implement the closed ProjectMemory artifact, Gate, provider, conclusion, synopsis, and traceability contracts with strict validators.

included: Provider-neutral schemas and validators for all eight approved PM interface intents.
Exact references, content digests, authority, disposition, checkpoint, receipt, and failure semantics.
Positive, malformed, substitution, additional-property, and installed-package fixtures.
excluded: Provider-owned baseline, Gate, or TraceabilityGraph authority.

deliverables.description: PM-001 schemas, validators, exports, and conformance fixtures.

checks.method: Validate canonical positive artifacts and exhaustive malformed, stale, substituted, additional-property, cloned-receipt, and digest-mismatch fixtures.
checks.successCriteria: Every PM authority-bearing artifact validates only under its exact closed contract and cannot be inferred from chat or mutated by a provider.

required-evidence.description: Every PM authority-bearing artifact validates only under its exact closed contract and cannot be inferred from chat or mutated by a provider.

workItems.objective: Implement idempotent /conclude, explicit qualitative-delta review, atomic ProjectMemoryGate promotion, synopsis regeneration, and concurrent-worker coordination.

included: Typed add, replace, supersede, retain, and reject candidates presented after each wave or completed task.
Exact owner dispositions, compare-and-swap baseline promotion, journaled recovery, and idempotent ConcludeReceipt.
Candidate-only worker conclusions with parent-session serialized promotion.
excluded: Silent memory writes, worker baseline mutation, or model-inferred approval.

deliverables.description: /conclude coordinator, ProjectMemoryGate, atomic baseline store, synopsis projector, and recovery journal.

dependency-hints.rationale: Conclusion applies the finalized authority, history, and candidate semantics.
Conclude and recovery must invalidate and refresh the exact current context.

checks.method: Test approve, reject, partial disposition, stale baseline, concurrent workers, retry, crash recovery, duplicate conclude, synopsis failure, graph failure, and atomic rollback.
checks.successCriteria: Only exact user-approved qualitative deltas promote, retries are idempotent, concurrent workers cannot overwrite each other, and baseline, synopsis, graph, and receipt remain consistent.

required-evidence.description: Only exact user-approved qualitative deltas promote, retries are idempotent, concurrent workers cannot overwrite each other, and baseline, synopsis, graph, and receipt remain consistent.

workItems.objective: Load CurrentSynopsis and exact ProjectMemory context first for every configured fresh task and refresh it deterministically at module boundaries.

included: First semantic context load with synopsis, exact baselines, decisions, blockers, recent sessions, and relevant traceability context.
Task, workspace, repository revision, artifact versions, digests, cache behavior, and duration receipts.
Unconcluded-session detection with explicit resume, conclude, or abandon routing.
excluded: Unrelated ChatGPT chats, undocumented tab-close hooks, or conversational memory as a substitute for pinned inputs.

deliverables.description: Context assembler, mandatory startup/refresh hook, briefing projection, and load receipts.

dependency-hints.rationale: Bootstrap requires authoritative namespace and retrieval semantics.

checks.method: Exercise fresh task, new day, restart, warm/cold cache, stale binding, missing synopsis, open session, refresh, and unrelated-chat fixtures.
checks.successCriteria: No configured DevRelay task begins with stale or missing project context, and every successful load is reconstructable from an exact receipt.

required-evidence.description: No configured DevRelay task begins with stale or missing project context, and every successful load is reconstructable from an exact receipt.

workItems.objective: Integrate ProjectMemory, /conclude, Mem0 configuration, and startup recovery into the supported ChatGPT/Codex Desktop Windows workflow and public package surface.

included: DevRelay skill and command guidance that loads memory first and reminds or blocks on required conclusion.
Module/plugin catalogs, maturity records, package exports, examples, ProjectOverview, lifecycle reports, and operator documentation.
Explicit local-only defaults, opt-in network behavior, supported-host claims, and migration guidance.
excluded: A one-click ChatGPT plug-in, hosted memory backend, unsupported automatic tab-close interception, or public npm publication.

deliverables.description: Desktop hooks, skill/command assets, catalogs, exports, examples, reports, and operator documentation.

dependency-hints.rationale: Desktop configuration must bind the verified provider surface.
Skill and command behavior must match final conclusion semantics.
Reports and context guidance must match final graph projection behavior.

checks.method: Run catalog, package export, installed-package import, command/skill fixture, documentation-link, report-parity, and supported-host claim checks.
checks.successCriteria: A Windows Desktop user can discover and operate the exact ProjectMemory lifecycle without hidden authority, stale docs, or unsupported product claims.

required-evidence.description: A Windows Desktop user can discover and operate the exact ProjectMemory lifecycle without hidden authority, stale docs, or unsupported product claims.

workItems.objective: Implement and attest a pinned local Mem0 adapter as a bounded derived-memory provider behind the ProjectMemory provider port.

included: Pinned Windows-local Mem0 installation and capability negotiation.
Bounded add, search, update, and delete proposal operations with raw execution receipts and native artifact archival.
Outbound source or embedding transmission disabled by default and explicit opt-in enforcement.
excluded: Direct baseline, Gate, graph, filesystem-wide, or implicit network authority.

deliverables.description: Live-conformant local Mem0 adapter, manifest, receipts, and provider-failure fixtures.

dependency-hints.rationale: The provider is bounded by the finalized native authority and fallback boundary.

checks.method: Invoke the pinned local provider for every bounded operation, archive exact receipts, and test unavailable, malformed, stale, network-denied, substitution, and fallback cases.
checks.successCriteria: Mem0 is live-provider-attested on Windows, remains derived and replaceable, and provider failure cannot silently corrupt or bypass ProjectMemory authority.

required-evidence.description: Mem0 is live-provider-attested on Windows, remains derived and replaceable, and provider failure cannot silently corrupt or bypass ProjectMemory authority.

workItems.objective: Implement deterministic ProjectMemory routing, namespace management, authority precedence, retrieval, history, and verified native fallback.

included: Project, session, and invocation-scoped module namespaces with deterministic routing.
Authority-over-recency conflict resolution and append, replace, supersede, retain, and reject semantics.
Bounded retrieval, history preservation, checkpoint replay, and equivalent verified native fallback.
excluded: Treating modules as autonomous agents or raw chat as authoritative memory.

deliverables.description: Native ProjectMemory engine, router, stores, retrieval, precedence, and replay behavior.

dependency-hints.rationale: The native engine must emit and consume the finalized PM contracts.

checks.method: Run deterministic namespace, authority conflict, retrieval, history, fallback, malformed-state, and zero-call replay matrices.
checks.successCriteria: Identical pinned inputs produce byte-identical context and candidates, lower-authority recent claims never override approved facts, and failures are fail-closed.

required-evidence.description: Identical pinned inputs produce byte-identical context and candidates, lower-authority recent claims never override approved facts, and failures are fail-closed.

workItems.objective: Add exhaustive ProjectMemory determinism, security, mutation, concurrency, performance, and transition-safe regression coverage.

included: Property, mutation, negative, checkpoint, graph, provider, installed-package, and Windows matrices.
Cold/warm context-load and bounded retrieval budgets with raw command, duration, version, and fingerprint receipts.
Historical release-fixture isolation from mutable current baselines.
excluded: Weakening fail-closed behavior or rewriting historical digests to conceal drift.

deliverables.description: PM-001 complete regression, performance, security, concurrency, and mutation suites.

dependency-hints.rationale: The complete matrix verifies the integrated module, provider, package, reports, and Desktop surface.

checks.method: Run focused suites, mutation and concurrency matrices, repeated canonical-byte comparisons, performance samples, canonical verify, catalog verification, and installed-package verification.
checks.successCriteria: All PM failure modes and authority boundaries are covered, deterministic repeats match, budgets pass, and the complete prior release gate remains green.

required-evidence.description: All PM failure modes and authority boundaries are covered, deterministic repeats match, budgets pass, and the complete prior release gate remains green.

workItems.objective: Implement trusted TraceabilityGraph context projection and ProjectMemory contribution without exposing graph authority to Mem0 or other adapters.

included: Read-only projection from an approved graph checkpoint into bounded memory context.
Deterministic links from approved memory facts and decisions to source artifacts and lifecycle entities.
Compact provenance and impact queries for why, coverage, and affected-change questions.
excluded: Direct provider graph reads, arbitrary relationship types, inverse-edge storage, or candidate-authored graph operations.

deliverables.description: Trusted traceability projector, contributor, query context, merge proofs, and orphan diagnostics.

dependency-hints.rationale: The trusted projector and contributor require finalized trace contracts.
Projected graph context must enter the bounded native retrieval path.

checks.method: Validate exact checkpoint projection, provider isolation, allowed vocabulary, source provenance, orphan detection, atomic merge, replay, and compact query fixtures.
checks.successCriteria: Memory can explain lifecycle provenance from exact graph facts while no untrusted provider can access or mutate the graph.

required-evidence.description: Memory can explain lifecycle provenance from exact graph facts while no untrusted provider can access or mutate the graph.

workItems.objective: Prove ProjectMemory end to end from fresh and worker ChatGPT/Codex Desktop tasks on Windows using the packed DevRelay library and live local Mem0 provider.

included: Fresh configured task loads CurrentSynopsis first and reconstructs exact approved context.
A worker produces a candidate-only conclusion; the parent reviews qualitative deltas, approves selected changes, runs /conclude, and refreshes context.
Restart and resume prove baseline, synopsis, history, traceability, receipts, provider evidence, and zero-call replay.
excluded: Public npm publication, hosted backend, implicit external transmission, or unsupported automatic tab-close behavior.

deliverables.description: Clean Windows Desktop ProjectMemory dogfood, release evidence, lifecycle report, milestone, and acceptance package.

dependency-hints.rationale: The release-defining Desktop run requires the complete green regression, security, and performance gate.

checks.method: Run the complete installed-package scenario in fresh, worker, parent, concluded, restarted, and resumed Desktop tasks and reconstruct every exact artifact and receipt.
checks.successCriteria: A user can leave and resume DevRelay with accurate context, explicitly govern every qualitative change, and trace the resulting memory through the complete lifecycle without conversational-memory dependence.

required-evidence.description: A user can leave and resume DevRelay with accurate context, explicitly govern every qualitative change, and trace the resulting memory through the complete lifecycle without conversational-memory dependence.
